topic: Distributed traces split into separate traces
environment: Python frontend calling Node backend over HTTP
symptom_pattern: Traces between a frontend and backend service used to be connected; now each service shows its own root span and the service map edge is gone.
root_cause: Header injection was disabled on the caller (DD_TRACE_PROPAGATION_STYLE_INJECT=none, set while trying to remove W3C headers), so no trace context reaches the backend.
resolution_path: Compare propagation env vars on both sides
Capture request headers at the backend (debug logs)
Restore injection of a style the backend extracts (datadog,tracecontext)
info_needed: a pair of trace IDs that should be linked

qa_pairs.tse_question: Have any DD_TRACE_PROPAGATION_* variables been set recently?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: We set INJECT=none on the frontend because a partner API complained about traceparent headers.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Do backend spans show a parent_id?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: parent_id is 0 on all of them.

customer_style.tone: articulate, has done some research, holds a wrong theory about a tracer bug
